name: BankrollNetworkStack donatePool dividend inflation
summary: donatePool() credits the donated WBNB to shareholders immediately and the same transaction can buy in and sell out, so a flash-loaned donate -> buy -> sell -> withdraw cycle returned more WBNB than it consumed.
